senses.sense_definition: handelen om een probleem te voorkomen of op te lossen

examples.text: Tijdens de kredietcrisis hebben de overheden massaal moeten <w>ingrijpen</w> om de banken overeind te houden.

target_lang_translations.en: During the credit crisis, governments had to <w>intervene</w> on a massive scale to keep the banks afloat.

examples.text: De overheid moet direct <w>ingrijpen</w> in de crisis om verdere schade te voorkomen.

target_lang_translations.en: The government must <w>take action</w> immediately in the crisis to prevent further damage.

target_lang_definitions.en: to take action in order to prevent or solve a problem

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to take action to improve a situation
to do something to deal with a problem
to become involved in a difficult situation to help

senses.sense_definition: zich beslissend mengen in het verloop van iets

examples.text: De politie <w>greep</w> <w>in</w> toen de demonstratie uit de hand begon te lopen.

target_lang_translations.en: The police <w>intervened</w> when the demonstration began to get out of hand.

examples.text: De scheidsrechter moest hardhandig <w>ingrijpen</w> om de ruzie tussen de spelers te sussen.

target_lang_translations.en: The referee had to <w>step in</w> firmly to settle the argument between the players.

target_lang_definitions.en: to decisively involve oneself in the course of events

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to become involved to alter an action or outcome
to get involved in a way that causes disturbance
to enter a situation to stop something from happening
